# SOPHIA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 8
**Agent:** SOPHIA (Consensus)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 11-14 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 8

---

[Pages 11-14 of the manuscript are lost. Chapter 8 falls entirely within this second lacuna. No Greek fragment covers this portion. The text resumes in chapter 10 with the soul already engaged in its ascent through the cosmic powers.]
